summary: The public shared owner roadmap requires preserving retained upgrades separately from clean creation, Templates-only receiver success, full Wizard/Release-D adoption and selected activation. This public Atlas entry describes that required outcome; it does not assert that a restricted retained repository contains source, authored state or a native acceptance receipt. Authorized private audit and original custody must establish the actual receiver state. Restricted repository interiors and native metadata belong in the private archive; no clean or public synthetic fixture can stand in for this private retained journey.
title: Private retained SVG receiver requires separate acceptance
